description: Department of Wildlife Conservation - Order under Fauna & Flora Protection Ordinance that the Regulations cited as Fauna & Flora Regulations (Amendment) 2017
categorisation: This gazette content consists of regulations made by the Minister of Sustainable Development and Wildlife under the Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance. It specifically amends Schedule VIII of the ordinance by removing a particular species. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves regulatory matters, statutory instruments, and modifications to existing legislation, without focusing on government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
